messages.subject: Project Granite — SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Please find our first draft of the Share Purchase Agreement. Headline points reflect the Heads: £41m equity consideration, £2.05m retention, full suite of business warranties and a tax covenant. The warranty cap is set at 100% of consideration with a 24-month general time limit, which we can discuss.

Look forward to your mark-up.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Granite — SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up is attached (redline against your v1). The principal changes: warranty cap reduced to 25% of consideration, general time limit reduced to 18 months, de minimis raised to £50,000, restrictive covenants cut to two years, and a 'so far as the Sellers are aware' qualifier added to the warranty at clause 6.1. The retention should sit in escrow for 12 months only.

Happy to talk these through.

Regards,

Jonathan Vane
Partner
Castle & Vane LLP
